question: Under what condition is mantra placement to be done on the bathing altar according to this instruction?
premises: The object or case is described as mobile.
The location is the bathing altar.
Mantra placement is said to occur there for the twice-born.
inference: If it is mobile, then on the bathing altar mantra placement should be done, O twice-born.
uncertainties: What is mobile is not named in these tokens.
plain_english: If it is mobile, O twice-born, mantra placement should be on the bathing altar.
